# Faerie Dice

> Faerie Dice is a browser tool for rolling dice with weighted probabilities that shift after each roll.

Faerie Dice lets you roll common polyhedral dice (d4 through d100). When weighted mode is on, each result slightly reduces that face's chance and redistributes probability across the others — so rolls feel less fair over time. You can also combine multiple dice with advantage, disadvantage, or sum.

- [Faerie Dice](/): Interactive weighted dice roller
